entry.title: Back-to-back cyber incidents at US financial investigators and spy agencies follow a string of federal hacks and outages
entry.summary: The US Financial Crimes Enforcement Network took systems offline as a precaution after unauthorized access. Hours earlier, reports emerged of a separate breach at the CIA, NGA, and ODNI, in which investigators suspect attackers used the AI defense tool Artex. Both incidents land on a US public that is already on edge.
